Director: George A. Romero Run Time: 120 min. Format: Digital Rating: R Release Year: 1982

Starring: Adrienne Barbeau, Carrie Nye, Fritz Weaver, Hal Holbrook, Leslie Nielsen, Ted Danson, Tom Atkins

Screenwriter: Stephen King

Producer: Richard P. Rubinstein

Horror titans Stephen King and George Romero team up for the ultimate 80s horror anthology just in time to give you the creeps for the whole month of October! Five grisly tales from a 1950s-style comic, including a murdered father rising from beyond, a bizarre meteor, a vengeful husband, a mysterious crate’s occupant, and a plague of cockroaches. With a dynamo cast, fabulous practical effects, chills, laughs, and Stephen King in his most viral acting role, there’s a reason Creepshow has remained a Halloween staple for nearly 45 years!
